en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European city square lined with ornate multi‑story buildings with arcades at street level and shuttered windows above. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the shopfronts. A tall column or lamp post stands at the left. Printed title text at the top reads "Graz" and "Luegg‑Hauptplatz," identifying the scene as the Luegg building area on the main square. Various German‑language shop signs are visible on the façades.
